task: Implement a mechanical DONE review assurance floor for Lattice code-changing stories.
outcome: When a developer tries to mark a code-changing story DONE without the required review assurance, the terminal shows a DONE Gate Checklist row named Review assurance floor with a concrete blocker such as zero current-material review evidence or failure-triggered 3x1 missing; when the evidence is valid, the same row passes while authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone remain false for local evidence.
facts: B-503b accepted docs/requirements/decisions/review-assurance-floor-execution-plan.md as the policy truth source.
Existing DONE checklist already consumes review-related gate rows from packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts and machine.canFinish mirrors those predicates.

Existing host verdict process events are written by autopilot_review_submit and checked by packages/main/src/core/host-independence.ts with materialDigest, validationDigest, promptDigest, host/session/key binding.
Existing review escalation only triggers on first REVIEW round countable findings >= 2, so a separate floor predicate is needed to catch zero-review material code DONE.
Local host verdict evidence is Non-authority and existing verdict summaries keep authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, and productionDone false.
constraints: Do not force every code change through 3x2 by default.
Do not treat docs-only typo/annotation work as material code diff.
Do not claim Authority Server completion without receipt-backed Authority proof.
Only fix the real correctness gap: DONE can close material code changes without the documented review assurance floor.
Follow consistency of logic by keeping DONE oracle, machine.canFinish, and guard failure reason on the same floor evaluator.
